r.s: Pure-PHP arbitrary precission integer arithmetic library
r.d: Supports base-2, base-10, base-16, and base-256 numbers. Uses the GMP or BCMath extensions, if available, and an internal implementation, otherwise.
r.n: - (internal, bcmath) use OpenSSL, if available, for modular exponentiation - (internal) use 64-bit ints, if available, and 64-bit floats, otherwise - (all) improve random number generation - change license to less restrictive MIT license
